title: Preparation of Extracted DNA for Long-Read Library Preparation
author: Natalie Solonenko
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6iyhcfw
materials: Recover DNA from the lid of the g-TUBE.

If your DNA is from an iron chloride precipitate resuspended with citrate buffer, clean up your DNA using the Qiagen DNeasy PowerClean Pro kit. Be sure to always mix gently by inversion or flicking, NOT vortexing or pipetting. Elute in 100ul. DNeasy PowerClean Pro Qiagen Catalog #12997-50

steps.title: Assess DNA Purity and Concentration
steps.instruction: Evaluate the purity and concentration of high molecular weight DNA using NanoDrop and Qubit.

substeps.instruction: For samples <5ng/ul, identify contaminants by looking for peaks not at 260nm rather than relying on 260/280 and 260/230 values.
Verify that 260/280 is between 1.7 - 2.1 and 260/230 is between 1.8 - 2.2 if a visible peak at 260nm is present.

steps.title: Perform DNA Clean-up if Necessary
steps.instruction: Clean up DNA if NanoDrop values are out of range, if peaks appear outside 260nm, or if contaminated with phenol/extraction reagents.

substeps.instruction: Perform an Ampure Bead clean-up using Ampure XP beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #A63881).

steps.title: Load DNA into Covaris g-TUBE
steps.instruction: Load at least 90ul of high molecular weight DNA into the top of a Covaris g-TUBE (Catalog #520079).

steps.title: Shear DNA to Target Size
steps.instruction: Shear the DNA using an Eppendorf 5424 or 5415 centrifuge with a 24 position rotor based on the desired fragment size.

substeps.instruction: For 15kb: Centrifuge at 4,700 rpm for 60 sec, flip the g-TUBE upside-down, and repeat centrifugation.
For 20kb: Centrifuge at 4,200 rpm for 60 sec, flip the g-TUBE upside-down, and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Assess Final DNA Size
steps.instruction: Verify the sheared DNA size using Genomic DNA TapeStation.

substeps.instruction: Dilute a small aliquot to 2 - 50ng/ul for assessment.
If DNA concentration is less than 2ng/ul, proceed without checking size.
